title: Reveal protocol: showdown verification and cheat detection
description: At showdown, players reveal encryption keys. Any party re-derives the full shuffle sequence to verify no card substitution. Invalid decryptions flag cheating. Integrates with BLAKE3 hash-chained event log for tamper-evident audit.
close_reason: verify_game: re-derives entire shuffle, decrypts with all keys, detects tampered cards. Tamper detection test passes.
